title: Wait'n on Sundown
meta_description: Find the perfect Destin, FL vacation rental at “Wait’n on Sundown”, a Gulf Front luxury 5-bed, 5.5-bath vacation villa. Ideal for 10 guests, this home offers a Rooftop Pool, Theater, Elevator & 6 Bikes. Book your memorable stay now!
description_expanded: Home Highlights: - Gulf Front - Private heated rooftop pool (Pool can be heated for an additional $30 per day between Oct 1 - May 1) - Complimentary beach setups include 2 chairs and 1 umbrella - Service provided Mar 1-Oct 31 - Gated Beachfront Access - Private Movie Theatre - Elevator - Soundproof dual acoustical panels and firewalls between units; soundproofing between floors; and sound mats under all levels Highly sought after end unit in Henderson Beach Villas, Destin's newest gulf front development. This expanded floor plan enjoys loads of extra light and expanded, covered outdoor spaces. With its gulf front location, private rooftop pool, luxurious in-unit amenities, elegant design, and a premier location in Crystal Beach, Henderson Beach Villas sets a new trend in sophisticated coastal lifestyles on the Emerald Coast. This villa is equipped with a private movie theatre, a rooftop pool, 4 floors of outdoor space, and an in-unit elevator. This 3,537-sqft, 5-bedroom villa features 4 floors of luxurious interiors with porcelain and hardwood floors; high-impact retractable glass sliders; 10' first-floor ceiling; quartz, marble, and quartzite surfaces in kitchen and baths; Sub-Zero and Wolf Appliances; and custom shaker cabinets. The beach is given center-stage at every chance. See-through glass surrounds on the balconies and rooftop deck elevate views of turquoise waters. The expanded, 348-sqft ground-floor patio extends deep into the sugary white sands to create optimal lounging. The 658-sqft-rooftop deck is the perfect post to watch Destin's famous sunsets across the Gulf of Mexico. In addition to the heated, 9'x16' pool, the rooftop includes a covered cabana and storage. The theatre room offers the next best view with full projection and raised seating. Henderson Beach Villas has considered every aspect of luxury coastal living, including privacy and noise with soundproof dual acoustical panels and firewalls between units; soundproofing between floors; and sound mats under all levels. This home offers 2 parking spaces, gated beachfront access, and a private beach walkover. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS Second Floor - King Master Suite with separate Shower and Tub King Bedroom with Shower Only Queen Bedroom with Shower Only Third Floor - King Bedroom with Shower Only King Bedroom with Shower Only **During peak season, all of our properties are rented with a 7-night minimum from Saturday to Saturday.**
